# M0 test assets (migration regression safety net)

Built per `docs/migration/05-regression-test-plan.md` §1. Native Swift tests
read this directory by relative path (zero sharing cost once the `native/`
project exists in this repository).

## Tracked vs regenerated

Git carries only the **provenance records** and the **pinned expectations**;
every payload is regenerated from its recorded source and is therefore
gitignored:

| Payload (gitignored) | Source of record | Regenerated by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rss/**/*.xml` — live buckets (standard / http_plain / redirect / ua_sensitive) | `rss/manifest.json` + `*.headers.txt` (url, sha256, captured_at, content type) + `tool/m0/feeds_curated.txt` | `tool/m0/fetch_rss.sh` |
| `rss/user_subs/*.xml` — the author's real subscription export | `rss/user_subs/manifest.json` + `*.headers.txt` + `tool/m0/feeds_user.txt` (source OPML's xmlUrls) | `tool/m0/fetch_user_subs.sh` |
| `rss/{missing_fields,giant,malformed,weird_dates}/*.xml` — constructed buckets | fixed seed + first `standard` manifest entry as template | `tool/m0/construct_rss_buckets.py` |
| `channels_index.json` | derived from the live corpus (385-feed channel index) | `tool/m0/fetch_rss.sh` |
| `api/**` — 10 endpoints × success+error branches | every URL and constructed body lives verbatim in the collector | `tool/m0/fetch_api.sh` |
| `audio/**` — 8s..2h05m samples, silence, VBR, AAC, garbage | deterministic ffmpeg recipes | `tool/m0/fetch_media.sh` |
| `opml/**` — app_export / overcast / xiaoyuzhou / giant_500 | `channels_index.json` + the app's real `generateOPML` | `tool/m0/fetch_media.sh`, `test/fixtures/generate_db_fixtures_test.dart` |
| `images/**` — 8 real covers | cover URLs in `channels_index.json` (first 8 with image) | `tool/m0/fetch_media.sh` |
| `db/**` — db_light/heavy/user/dirty/v3/crashed/corrupt ×3/edge_subs/smoke + cache meta DBs + tmp audio | the app's real table creators, models and insertion algorithms over the corpus; `db_user` = the author's real subscription set (stands in for a device pull, 05 §1.1 fallback c); `db_smoke` = the reproducible `-m2-smoke-play` container (player pointer set, cached head with in-file progress, far-future validTill — 2026-09-23 correction for an unreproducible earlier record) | `test/fixtures/generate_db_fixtures_test.dart` |
| `db/db_device/` — real iOS container | the app itself: `integration_test/m0_seed_test.dart` boots the real app on a simulator, imports the author's 25 subscriptions via the real share-dialog path, queues episodes, and plays one — then the container is pulled during the test's hold window (`xcrun simctl get_app_container`); note the real audio cache lives at `Library/Caches/anycast_episode/`, not `tmp/` | `integration_test/m0_seed_test.dart` + `tool/m0/feeds_user.txt` |

Tracked in git:

- `test/fixtures/rss/**/manifest.json` and `rss/**/*.headers.txt` — capture
  records; the `sha256` fields let you audit drift after re-collecting.
- `test/golden/` — G1–G16 + G_palette expectations exported from the old
  implementation's real logic (pinned to 1.2.1+38).
- `tool/m0/` collectors/generators and this README.

## Bootstrap / regeneration

```bash
tool/m0/regen_all.sh          # offline: rebuild db fixtures + goldens from the
                              # corpus materialized on this machine
tool/m0/regen_all.sh --live   # re-collect the live corpus first (network:
                              # rss + api + covers), then rebuild everything
```

On a fresh clone the payloads are absent **by design** — bootstrap once with
`--live` (needs network, ffmpeg, python3). Live content drifts over time, so
`--live` also refreshes every golden derived from it; the manifest `sha256`
values record which bytes each golden was cut against.

Single steps:

```bash
flutter test --dart-define=m0-regen=true test/fixtures/generate_db_fixtures_test.dart
flutter test --dart-define=m0-regen=true test/golden/export_golden_test.dart
```

Plain `flutter test` (no define) always skips the generator/exporter, so the
ordinary test suite never touches or rewrites this directory.

## Notes

- The db generator and the golden exporter must live OUTSIDE their output
  directories (a past generator inside `test/fixtures/db/` deleted its own
  source during cleanup).
- `sqflite_common_ffi` under `flutter test` redirects relative database paths
  to `.dart_tool/sqflite_common_ffi/databases/` — the generator always opens
  absolute paths.
- Cache meta databases really use columns
  `_id/url/key/relativePath/eTag/validTill/touched/length` (`relativePath`
  stores only the file name, resolved via `<tmp>/<cacheKey>/`) — corrects the
  older "path" wording in `docs/migration/01` §1.2.
- Error-path audio URLs: serve locally with
  `python3 tool/m0/serve_local.py test/fixtures/audio` (URLs listed in
  `audio/error_urls.txt`).
